t: A five-step unplugged lesson sequence that helps students decide what counts as AI.
steps: Find the Recognising AI lesson sequence on the Digital Technologies Hub site.
Download and print the card sets and handouts.
Print the pre-lesson handout called What I know about AI.
Cut out the Does it use AI card sort.
Open the online tools for step 2 and test them on a student device.
Open the Scratch projects for steps 4 and 5 and check that they load.
Run the five steps in order over several lessons.
